// @path: src/lib/ops/reads.ts
// @expect: OPS-GROUP-KEY
// Proves classifying JobRun and MailCounter as OPS_OWNED did not quietly open
// the aggregate rules. OPS_OWNED means "this table is about the system, not its
// users", not "grouping is unrestricted": SAFE_GROUP_KEYS still governs every
// groupBy under the ops roots, and templateKey is not on it.
import { db } from "@/lib/db";

export async function perTemplate() {
  return db.mailCounter.groupBy({ by: ["templateKey"], _count: true });
}
